title: Advances in hydroformylation with formaldehyde, formic acid and carbon dioxide as syngas surrogates

Zerun Zhao, Shuai Lei, Wanru Feng, Xingyong Wang, Hongchen Li, He Chen, Lu Wang, Fujun Zhao, Songbao Fu
This review examines recent advances in hydroformylation with formaldehyde, formic acid, and CO2 as carbonyl surrogates, focusing on mechanisms, catalysts, substrates, limitations, and future opportunities.
